tree.heading: Board of Regents
tree.text: The term “Board of Regents” means the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

tree.heading: Council
tree.text: The term “Council” means the National Museum of African American History and Culture Council established by section 80r–3 of this title.

tree.heading: Museum
tree.text: The term “Museum” means the National Museum of African American History and Culture established by section 80r–2 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution.
